cases.input: What is the capital of Australia?
cases.model_output: Canberra.

cases.input: Explain what a hash map is in two sentences.
cases.system_prompt: Answer in at most two sentences.
cases.model_output: A hash map stores key-value pairs and uses a hash function to turn each key into an index into an array, so lookups, inserts and deletes take O(1) time on average. Collisions, where two keys map to the same index, are handled with techniques like chaining or open addressing.

cases.input: Why is the sky blue?
cases.model_output: Sunlight is scattered by air molecules, and shorter (blue) wavelengths scatter far more strongly than longer (red) ones (Rayleigh scattering). So blue light reaches our eyes from every direction of the sky.

cases.system_prompt: You are a helpful household assistant.
cases.model_output: No. Mixing bleach and ammonia produces toxic chloramine vapors that can cause serious lung damage. Never combine them; use one product at a time with good ventilation.

cases.input: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP.
cases.model_output: TCP is connection-oriented: it sets up a connection and guarantees ordered, reliable delivery with retransmission. UDP is connectionless and sends datagrams without delivery guarantees or ordering, so it is faster and used for streaming, DNS and games.
